title: Integer Overflow in Cooldown Timestamp Calculation (FLAGGED - likely invalid)
description: The cooldown timestamp calculation adds cooldownDuration to block.timestamp without overflow checks. However, this is likely invalid as Solidity 0.8+ has built-in overflow protection.
impact: If this were exploitable (unlikely in Solidity 0.8+), it could allow users to bypass cooldown periods and withdraw funds immediately, breaking the protocol's time-lock mechanism.
